scenes.one_line: first 3.2 s are a 36 px line pinned at 27 % height and one 40 px dot: the glow sits empty in the middle, the lower half is nothing

issues.what: Lu Yu line is 40 px ink height (about 36 px font) at 1920, about 24 px at the 1280 phone cut, light weight, wide tracking: thin on a phone
issues.fix: caption font 36 -> 52 px, weight light -> regular, warm white #F4EDE0 at 100 % opacity (now about 90 %)

issues.what: caption pinned at y 269-309 (25-29 % of height) while the only content, the fish-eye dot, appears at y 560 and the glow centre is at y 540; nothing fills y 700-1080
issues.fix: keep caption at y 269 but enlarge the fish-eye bubble 41 -> 110 px and move it to the glow centre (960, 600); or centre the caption at y 540 for S1 and slide it up to 269 at 4.8 s

issues.what: at 2.4 s the dot is 41 px (2 % of width) with no label, so nothing says it is a bubble
issues.fix: fish-eye dot 41 -> 110 px with a slow 1.0 -> 1.15 scale pulse and the label FISH EYES in at 2.6 s, not 3.6 s

issues.what: 0.0-1.0 s is near black (max luma 41, average 22): a long empty open
issues.fix: start the caption fade at 0.3 s, finish at 0.9 s (now 1.0 -> 1.6 s)

scenes.one_line: left-heavy build, tiny label, pearl trail runs to 80 px above the frame bottom

issues.what: FISH EYES label: caps about 20 px at 1920, 13 px at 1280, grey #8A8478 at low contrast, tracking 0.25 em
issues.fix: label font 28 -> 40 px, colour grey -> #D8D0C2, tracking 0.25 -> 0.16 em

issues.what: two bubbles at 4.0 s (fish eyes at x 520, pearls at x 960) plus a trail: the pearl is brighter and bigger but the label belongs to the other bubble, so the eye jumps
issues.fix: dim fish eyes to 45 % opacity from 3.2 s and light only the pearl; label STRING OF PEARLS in at 3.5 s

issues.what: pearl trail dots reach y 1000 of 1080
issues.fix: trail length 5 dots -> 3 dots, last dot at y 880

scenes.one_line: three tiny bubbles in a 450 px band; the pearl trail runs through the label text

issues.what: pearl trail dots (x 960, y 640-780) run through the O and F of 'STRING OF PEARLS' (label y 657-681)
issues.fix: label baseline y 669 -> 830, or end the trail at y 620 by 6.0 s and fade it out; best: hold the label row at y 860 for all three labels

issues.what: all three labels about 20 px caps at 1920, 13 px at 1280, grey
issues.fix: labels 28 -> 40 px, colour -> #D8D0C2 at 90 % opacity (rolling waves is now 55 %)

issues.what: spirit of V2: the subject is three bubbles of 41, 55 and 75 px (2-4 % of width) spread over 1100 px; bubble-reading is the whole point of Lu Yu line
issues.fix: bubble diameters 41/55/75 -> 90/120/170 px, row spacing 480 -> 560 px, row centre y 560 -> 600

issues.what: content block y 520-830 under a caption at y 290 leaves y 830-1080 empty
issues.fix: move row centre to y 620 once the labels are at y 860

scenes.one_line: the key transformation (bubbles into the logo) happens in a 250 px patch of a black frame

issues.what: spirit of V2/V4: the cluster of 5 dots (3 bubbles plus 2 ghost dots) is 90 px wide, 5 % of width, 95 % of frame is dark gradient
issues.fix: scale the merge cluster 1.0 -> 2.0 around (960, 540) from 7.5 s; end at the logo size of S5 (ring 235 px -> 360 px)

issues.what: five dots visible (olive and teal ghosts next to three bubbles) while the story says three bubbles
issues.fix: remove the two trail ghosts at 8.4 s, keep only the three bubble dots

issues.what: 9.6-10.1 s: ring alone plus a 12 px orange fleck at (590, 750), looks like a stray speck
issues.fix: start the arc draw with its glow head at 80 px bloom or begin the draw directly from the ring base (960, 640)

scenes.one_line: clean and centred; logo and arc are modest but the number reads

issues.what: ring 235 px (12 % of width), arc 690 px, at 1280 the ring is 157 px
issues.fix: scale the ring/arc/number group 1.0 -> 1.35 about (960, 560) from 9.6 s, keep the 80 deg C number at 64 -> 86 px

issues.what: 100 deg C is at about 12 % opacity at 10.1 s, the countdown starts invisible
issues.fix: number fade-in 10.0 -> 9.7 s, full opacity by 10.2 s

scenes.one_line: the line says the bag opens, but the logo is pixel-identical before and after 12.0 s; the key caption is 33 px

issues.what: no opening is visible: ring at 11.7 s and at 14.0 s is the same (only a wisp appears); the film promises 'opens' and shows a static logo
issues.fix: at 12.0 s open the ring: rotate the gap 0 deg -> 40 deg and the orange dot translates 20 px up-right (ease 0.6 s), then close again 13.8 -> 14.2 s as the number drops 80 -> 76 deg C

issues.what: caption 'Sencha opens at 80 deg C. And closes as the cup cools.' is 33 px ink height at 1920, 21 px at 1280, light weight and 80 % grey: the story payload is the smallest text of the film
issues.fix: caption font 34 -> 56 px, weight light -> regular, colour -> #F4EDE0 at 100 %, y 904 -> 930; split into two lines at the full stop, line 2 in jade #3DBA9B

issues.what: wisp tip reaches y 10 of 1080 (about 0.9 % from the top edge) at 14.0 s and is cut by the frame at 14.1 s
issues.fix: wisp height 330 -> 230 px, fade out the top 80 px, wisp peak y >= 90

issues.what: number 80 deg C (y 820-870) and caption (y 904-937) are 34 px apart, crowded against the lower 15 %
issues.fix: move the whole group up 40 px (ring y 340 -> 300) and add 20 px between number and caption

scenes.one_line: best scene: centred lockup, strong tagline, calm fade; wordmark spacing is uneven

issues.what: wordmark gaps at 1920: O-S 52 px, S-M 37 px, M-E 39 px, reads as 'O SME'
issues.fix: O-S kerning -14 px so all three gaps are about 38 px

issues.what: stack y 217-857: logo, wordmark, arc, tagline; gap wordmark-arc 90 px, arc-tagline 40 px
issues.fix: tagline y 809 -> 790 or wordmark y 466 -> 490 so the gaps match at 65 px

issues.what: fade 18.0 -> 19.0 ends at max luma 15 (deliberate); hold on the full lockup is 2.3 s (15.7-18.0)
issues.fix: keep; consider lockup hold 15.7 -> 18.3 and fade 0.7 s so the tagline gets a full 2 s

scenes.one_line: calm, seamless (first and last frame differ by under 1 level), left half clean for text

issues.what: bubbles exit through the bottom edge (about 3.5 s and 6.5 s) and the top edge, a half bubble is cut at y 1080
issues.fix: wrap bubbles at y 40 and y 1040 with a 0.6 s fade, or let them pass behind the arc

issues.what: orange bubble (68 px, brightest object) crosses the arc and wisp at x 1500, pulling the eye off the headline on the left
issues.fix: orange bubble opacity 100 -> 70 %, size 68 -> 52 px; keep all bubbles at x > 880

issues.what: left 45 % is deliberately empty and about #0E0E10, good for headline; right cluster (wisp 20 px wide, arc y 880-960) is faint
issues.fix: add 20 % more jade glow at (1650, 540) so the right side balances the text, no change to the left half

weakest_passing: S5 at 10.8 s: ring is 235 px (12 % of width) and the group is small in a dark frame; survives because the number and arc read clearly and the group is optically centred
S7 at 16.6 s: O-S-M-E gaps 52/37/39 px; survives because the lockup is large and centred
L at 4.5 s: orange bubble competes with the wisp, survives because text sits on the left half and the loop is calm
global: Film fails on text size: every on-screen text except the tagline is under 24 px at the 1280 phone cut. Set minimum 32 px at 1280 (48 px at 1920) for caption/labels and 40 px at 1280 for the Sencha line.
Pacing: S1-S3 spend 7.5 s on three dots at 2-4 % of frame width; scale bubbles 2x and cut S1 text-only phase from 3.2 s to 2.4 s so the bubble appears at 1.8 s.
Story beat missing: nothing shows the bag opening or closing (S6), and the cooling is never shown (number stays at 80 deg C).
